summary.text: Chris Spencer is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Sean Huffman.
He won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary over Josh Bray.

paragraphs.text: Spencer previously ran for the same seat in 2024, finishing second to incumbent Gary VanDeaver in the March 5 Republican primary and then losing the May 28, 2024 runoff, 53.5% to 46.5%.
In 2026 the seat has no incumbent, and Spencer defeated Bray in the Republican primary, 50.9% to 49.1%.
Ballotpedia lists endorsements from Texas Right to Life, the True Texas Project and Young Conservatives of Texas.
